advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that monkeypatches get_runner to raise and asserts code_review_decision returns a fail-closed BLOCK ('review-error') decision when a runtime is forwarded.
evidence: adapter.py added: `runner = get_runner(...)` wrapped in `except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — a runner build failure is a fail-closed BLOCK` -> `return _block("review-error", {}, merge_commits=merge_commits)`

Searches for `runner build` and `get_runner` in tests/unit find only the happy-path forwarding spy (test_rp04_s5_decision_auth_heldout.py, test_rp04_s5_startup.py) which returns a real runner; no test makes get_runner raise on this seam.
This is a fail-closed security-relevant path new to the diff; a regression that silently swallowed the failure or returned PASS would not be caught.
advisory.finding: The adapter's new fail-closed BLOCK path when the runner build raises is untested: `except Exception ... return _block("review-error", ...)` after `get_runner(...)` in code_review_decision has no test injecting a get_runner failure to assert the BLOCK/review-error decision.
scenarios: get_runner raises (misconfig, provider import failure) while a runtime is forwarded
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_rp04_s5_startup.py, add a test that sets runner_mod.get_runner to raise and asserts adapter.code_review_decision(..., runtime=LLMRuntime())['decision'] == 'BLOCK' (review-error tag).

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test driving app._worker(queue, cfg, runtime=sentinel) (or lifespan wiring) that asserts review_and_vote is called with runtime=sentinel.
evidence: app.py lifespan added: `binding = getattr(app.state, 'startup_binding', None)`; `runtime = binding.llm_runtime if binding is not None else None`; worker created with `_worker(app.state.queue, cfg, runtime)`.
_worker added branch: `if runtime is None: review = _voter.review_and_vote(...) else: review = _voter.review_and_vote(..., runtime=runtime)`.

Searches for `startup_binding` and `compose_startup_binding` in tests find only startup.py-level tests (test_rp04_s5_startup.py / test_rp04_s5_rotation_heldout.py); no test drives app._worker or lifespan to assert the composed runtime reaches review_and_vote.
Existing _worker tests (test_review_bot.py:1668, test_review_bot_retrigger.py) call _worker without a runtime, so the else-branch forwarding is unexercised.
advisory.finding: The app-level runtime-forwarding wiring is untested: no test asserts that lifespan composes the startup binding and that _worker threads the composed runtime into review_and_vote(..., runtime=...). Coverage stops at compose_startup_binding in isolation and at the voter accepting a runtime kwarg.
scenarios: Worker drains an event with a composed startup binding present; the forwarded runtime must reach the review
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_review_bot.py, spy on _voter.review_and_vote and run app._worker(queue, cfg, runtime=rt) with one queued event, asserting the call received runtime=rt.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the adapter-injected runner (built from the pre-re-rooting cfg) does not reintroduce bug pelt-mead-aeon, or build it from the re-rooted cfg like gate_dispatch does.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:477: `# Rebuild the runner from the RE-ROOTED cfg (bug pelt-mead-aeon): the preflight runner baked the`
dropped.finding: The runner injected on CodeReviewRequest is built from LLMConfig.from_env(repo_root=repo_root) — the pre-re-rooting cfg — whereas gate_dispatch deliberately rebuilds the runner from the re-rooted snapshot cfg (bug pelt-mead-aeon: 'the preflight runner baked the pre-snapshot cfg; reusing it hits the bare clone'). When request.runner is provided the gate keeps it as-is (`runner_sel = request.runner or get_runner(cfg)`), so a pre-re-rooting runner is used verbatim; confirm the runner is not cfg/repo-root sensitive in a way that reintroduces that bug.
